description: You can capture the portion of a course number that determines its level.

steps.description: parse_course_level accepts a string or None. Empty input returns None before matching.
The pattern matches department letters, an optional hyphen, and three digits. Only the first digit sits in a capture group.

steps.answer: It captures 2 and multiplies by 100, giving 200.
steps.question: What does the function return for MATH210-NAME?

steps.description: A successful match becomes a level number. The displayed cases return None for Intro, an empty string, and None.

title: Capture the course-level digit
